title: Paul Travels to Jerusalem and Agabus's Prophecy
description: On the journey to Jerusalem, Paul and his companions stop at Tyre, where the disciples warn him through the Spirit not to go on. They continue via Ptolemais to Caesarea, where they stay with the evangelist Philip and his four prophesying daughters. The prophet Agabus comes down from Judea, takes Paul's belt, binds himself, and predicts that the Jews in Jerusalem will bind Paul and hand him over to the Gentiles. Paul cannot be persuaded and says he is ready to die for the name of Jesus. In Jerusalem, the brothers welcome him, and following James' advice, he goes into the temple to be purified. Then he is seized by Jews from Asia, a crowd beats him, and the Roman commander arrests him and takes him away amid shouts of "Away with him!"
